description:
## Approved plan task A2

- **Functional scope/files:** add `:web_ingress` handling in `channels/api.ex`; implement `WebBridge.from_listener/3` and command/message dispatch. Extend `communication_bridge.ex` only as necessary to preserve selected-agent routing, explicit BO permissions and history/filter inputs. Add BO `BridgeClient` construction/dispatch helpers without wiring ChatLive yet.
- **Engine scope:** reuse conversation/create/messages for BO restoration and the routing admission/finalization lifecycle for messages. Initialization/welcome seeding must remain single-owned; split an Engine Action prerequisite only if genuinely new composition is required. BO conversation history and canonical transcripts are not interchangeable IDs or projections.
- **Tests before implementation:** real Channels → Engine routing integration; assert Incoming is built in WebBridge, actor/routing context and admission/finalization survive, BO bypass remains explicit, no duplicate user/assistant persistence occurs, foreign/untrusted context is rejected, commands do not enter the Agent pipeline, and errors return structured responses.
- **Branches:** init create/resume/BO missing-conversation fallback, empty history, Engine unavailable, invalid command, invalid actor, default/configured agent and filters. Preserve current welcome-message and history semantics.
- **Mocking:** real internal dispatch/DB; external model edge only. Isolate child-process DB ownership.
- **Documentation:** public ingress signature, supported domain action and BO trusted-context contract.
- **Action reuse:** reuse `CommunicationBridge` routing Event builders, Engine conversation API and persistence context. Any cohesive new initialization Action is Engine-owned, invoked through its domain boundary, and is not automatically an agent tool. No Engine → Agent-tool → Engine recursion.
- **Done:** tests can send a BO-shaped shared Message/Command through the supported role API without changing the UI consumer.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write the specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.
title: [830] A2 — Implement WebBridge ingress and BO command orchestration through role boundaries
